text:
## Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD)  
**For Higher-Risk Customers:**
- High-net-worth individuals (>£500k)
- PEPs (Politically Exposed Persons)
- Businesses in high-risk industries
- Customers in high-risk countries  
**Additional Steps:**
- Verify source of funds
- Obtain business documents
- Understand purpose of account
- Ongoing monitoring
- Regular review

raw_entities.name: Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) Training
raw_entities.description: A training section focused on the Enhanced Due Diligence process for customers identified as higher-risk. It outlines the specific customer categories requiring EDD and the additional verification steps necessary.

raw_entities.name: High-Net-Worth Individual (>£500k) (KYC Red Flag)
raw_entities.description: A risk indicator where a customer is identified as a high-net-worth individual with assets exceeding £500,000, triggering the need for Enhanced Due Diligence.

raw_entities.name: Politically Exposed Person (PEP) (KYC Red Flag)
raw_entities.description: A risk indicator where a customer is identified as a Politically Exposed Person, requiring higher scrutiny and EDD processes.

raw_entities.name: Business in High-Risk Industry (KYC Red Flag)
raw_entities.description: A risk indicator where a business customer operates within an industry classified as high-risk, necessitating enhanced verification.

raw_entities.name: Customer in High-Risk Country (KYC Red Flag)
raw_entities.description: A risk indicator where a customer is located in or associated with a high-risk jurisdiction, triggering EDD requirements.

raw_entities.name: Verify Source of Funds
raw_entities.description: A mandatory requirement to verify the origin of the customer's funds as part of the Enhanced Due Diligence process for high-risk customers.

raw_entities.name: Obtain Business Documents
raw_entities.description: A mandatory requirement to collect and verify official business documentation for high-risk corporate entities.

raw_entities.name: Understand Purpose of Account
raw_entities.description: A mandatory requirement to establish and document the intended nature and purpose of the account for high-risk customers.

raw_entities.name: Ongoing Monitoring
raw_entities.description: A continuous compliance duty to monitor the activity of high-risk accounts to ensure it aligns with the established customer profile.

raw_entities.name: Regular Review
raw_entities.description: A mandatory requirement to perform periodic reviews of high-risk customer files to ensure due diligence remains current.

raw_entities.name: Higher-Risk Customer
raw_entities.description: Customers who meet specific risk criteria (HNW, PEP, high-risk industry/country) and are therefore subject to Enhanced Due Diligence.

raw_entities.name: Enhanced Due Diligence Process
raw_entities.description: The specialized KYC process involving additional verification steps for customers identified as high-risk.
